description: Shows the user the templates they can build a slide deck in, each with a preview of its look, when the client can show a picker. Pass reportId when they pick one for an existing report: each template then warns about the report's slides it has no layout for. Picking one sends you a message naming the template: then apply it with applyReportTemplate, or start a report in it with createReport's templateId, as the user asked. Answers the templates as listTemplates does, for clients that can't show the picker.

reportId.description: The report the user picks a template for, by its `id` from `listReports`: the picker warns about the slides each template has no layout for. Its `type` must be `SlideDeck`, and you need edit access to it. Leave it out when the user picks one for a new report.

name: showTemplates
title: Show templates
